description: Cross-workspace references (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.3): [alias]path resolves into another workspace; ['quoted path'] / [bare.dnatree] are direct paths; a bracket prefix is always absolute from that workspace's root (so ^ after it is rejected). Engine carrier is OxFml External(ExternalRef) -> OxCalc HostSensitive, live-latest by default. `expect.target_workspace` names the resolving workspace. The 'accounts' workspace registers alias 'projections' -> the projections workspace.

cases.name: [alias]path resolves into the aliased workspace
cases.note: A bracket prefix is absolute from the selected workspace's root; live-latest by default.

cases.name: [alias] + bracket-escaped first segment
cases.note: [ws][Branch X].MyNode — workspace selector then a bracket-escaped node name.

cases.name: ['quoted path'] is always a workspace selector
cases.note: A quoted-path bracket is unconditionally a workspace selector; here it denotes the same projections workspace.

cases.name: [alias] alone resolves to the aliased workspace root

expect.engine_ref: workspace root of the aliased workspace

cases.note: Analogous to [] = current root; the manifest is consulted before any bare-escaped-name fallback (§3.3 disambiguation).
